title: Guarding the main call
description: You can separate reusable functions from the call made when a file runs directly.

steps.description: double returns its argument multiplied by two. You can reuse this function without printing a value.
main calls double with 21 and prints the returned value. Defining main saves this work for a later call.

steps.question: When the file runs directly, does the guard call main?
steps.answer: Yes. __name__ is '__main__' for direct execution, so the condition passes.

steps.description: The recorded run reaches main and prints 42. When you import the file as tools, this guard leaves main uncalled.
